Funda itafile ngocwangciso lonyaka, isalathiso samaxabiso, unyuko ngaphezu konyaka odlulileyo. Unyuko uqokelelwe kwindawo e-1 yedesimali.

y-m-73-05.title: Ingaba abantu bangakhetha ngokwahlukileyo nokuba amaxabiso alindelekileyo ayafana?

y-m-73-05.material: Ukuba usebenzisa ifowuni unyaka, isikrini sayo sinokophuka. Njengemeko yenganekwane, ithuba lokophuka kunyaka omnye li-6% (thatha ukuba lingophuka kanye ngonyaka ubuninzi), yaye ukuba iyaphuka, iindleko zokulungisa zi-40만 원. I-inshorensi yomonakalo igubungela iindleko zonke zokulungisa ukuba ubhatala i-premium yonyaka ye-2만 4천 원 (i-deductible ye-0 won). Thatha ukuba ithuba liyaziwa ngokuchanekileyo.

y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.a: Amaxabiso alindelekileyo ayafana, ngoko nokuba ukhetha eyiphi, imali oyisebenzisayo ngokwenene ngonyaka ngamnye ifana ngqo.

y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.b: 6% lithuba elincinci, ngoko umonakalo awuyi kwenzeka, yaye ukuthenga i-inshorensi lilahleko nje.

y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.c: I-premium incinci kakhulu kuneendleko zokulungisa, ngoko ukuthenga i-inshorensi kuyinzuzo ngaphandle kwemeko.

y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba ingeniso yamanye amakhaya inkulu kakhulu, umndilili uyatsalwa. Umndilili yi-500, kodwa amakhaya ama-4 kwama-5 anokuba li-400 okanye ngaphantsi. Ukugweba ngomndilili wodwa akwanelanga; kufuneka ujonge nexabiso eliphakathi.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ayikhankanyi imeko apho inyani, kodwa idibana nenqaku eliphambili

y-m-73-02.prereq.3: Ileyibhile ye-H3 kulo msebenzi sisikhumbuzi sobunzima seli qela lemveliso kuphela; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibela oku kwibanga elithile. Ingcamango: umfundi odibana nemathematika yezoqoqosho okokuqala kwinqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphezulu.
y-m-73-02.title: Ngaba indawo enexabiso eliphantsi kakhulu lento nganye yeyona nenzuzo enkulu?
y-m-73-02.topic: Ixabiso eliqhelekileyo kunye nemveliso enenzuzo enkulu
y-m-73-02.goal: Qinisekisa ukuba imveliso enexabiso eliqhelekileyo eliphantsi kakhulu kwento nganye kunye nemveliso enenzuzo enkulu zinokwahluka, ulungisa isigwebo sakho njengoko ulwazi ngexabiso ngalunye lunikwa.
y-m-73-02.material:
Indawo yokusebenzela yesesepha esenziwe ngezandla yenza izinto ezingama-q (i-integer) ngenyanga kwaye izithengisa zonke. Ixabiso elipheleleyo lenyanga enye yi-C(q) = 50 + 10q + q² (iyunithi: 천 원). Kuloo, i-50 lixabiso elisisigxina, elihlawulwa inyanga nganye nokuba akukho nto enye yenziwe. Inzuzo = ixabiso lokuthengisa × q − C(q). Ixabiso eliqhelekileyo lento nganye yi-C(q) ÷ q. (q² ifundwa 'q isikwere'.)

Imveliso q (izinto) | Ixabiso elipheleleyo (천 원) | Ixabiso eliqhelekileyo lento nganye (천 원)
1 | 61 | 61.00
3 | 89 | 29.67
5 | 125 | 25.00
7 | 169 | 24.14
8 | 194 | 24.25
10 | 250 | 25.00
15 | 425 | 28.33
20 | 650 | 32.50

(Funda itheyibhile ngolu landelelwano q, ixabiso elipheleleyo, ixabiso eliqhelekileyo. Phakathi kwamaxabiso e-integer e-q, ixabiso eliqhelekileyo eliphantsi kakhulu likwi-q=7.)
y-m-73-02.prereq.2: Ukwahlula ixabiso eliqhelekileyo (lento nganye) kunye nexabiso elipheleleyo
y-m-73-02.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi ngamaxabiso luya kuvezwa icandelo linye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo esifanelekileyo kakhulu ngoku.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, kuqala bhala phantsi ukuba ngawaphi amanani oyaziyo ngoku nangawaphi amanani ongakawazi.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha amanani amabini okanye amathathu uwathelekise ngqo ukuze ujonge ukuba isigwebo osikhethileyo sihambelana namanani enzuzo avezwayo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Wazi kuphela itheyibhile engasentla. Awukazi ixabiso lokuthengisa lento nganye.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Singathi 'inzuzo inkulu xa kwenziwa izinto ezi-7, apho ixabiso eliqhelekileyo liphantsi kakhulu'?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Inzuzo ixhomekeke kwixabiso lokuthengisa, ngoko itheyibhile yamaxabiso yodwa ayinakuxela ukuba yeyiphi imveliso enika inzuzo enkulu. Okwangoku, 'ukugcina isigwebo' yeyona mpendulo ixhaswe kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ewe. Kwizinto ezi-7, apho ixabiso lento nganye liphantsi kakhulu, inzuzo nayo inkulu kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubophe ixabiso eliphantsi ngqo kwinzuzo ephezulu. Inzuzo ikwaxhomekeke kwixabiso lokuthengisa, ngoko ayinakuqinisekiswa ngetheyibhile yamaxabiso yodwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ngaphandle kokwazi ixabiso lokuthengisa awukwazi ukubala inzuzo, ngoko kusekuseni ukugweba ngoku.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awulibalanga ukuba inzuzo ngumahluko phakathi kwengeniso neendleko. Ukhombe ukuba lulwazi luni olongezelelweyo olufuneka lwaziwe.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Okukhona wenza izinto ezimbalwa ngaphantsi kwe-7, kokukhona indleko yento nganye iphantsi, ngoko inzuzo inkulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Etafileni, imveliso ephantsi (izinto ezi-5, izinto ezi-3) empeleni ineendleko eziphezulu ngento nganye. Kufuneka uphinde uhlole indlela yokufunda itafile.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Ixabiso lokuthengisa ngento nganye liyaziwa ukuba li-40 (천 원). Ukubala inzuzo = 40q − C(q), inzuzo yi-111 ukuba q=7, 150 ukuba q=10, 175 ukuba q=15, 150 ukuba q=20, kwaye 75 ukuba q=25.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wawugweba njani ngoku? (Ngaphakathi kwemveliso eboniswe etafileni)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba ixabiso lokuthengisa liphezulu kakhulu kuneendleko eziphakathi ze-24.14, ngoko xa wenza izinto ezingaphezulu kwe-7, ingeniso eyongezelelweyo inkulu kuneendleko eziyongezelelweyo, ngoko inzuzo iyanda ngakumbi. Inzuzo inkulu kakhulu kwizinto ezili-15 ngo-175 (ubala amanani aphelele), yaye emva koko iyehla.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inzuzo inkulu kakhulu xa wenza izinto ezi-7, apho iindleko eziphakathi zilelona phantsi.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Amaxabiso amakhulu kune-111 yezinto ezi-7 avela kwizinto ezili-10 (150) nakwizinto ezili-15 (175). Thelekisa namanani owasandula ukuwahlola.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Okukhona wenza izinto ezininzi, kokukhona inzuzo iqhubeka isanda.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ujonga izinto ezingama-20 (150) nezinto ezingama-25 (75), ukusuka kwindawo ethile inzuzo iyehla. Olu gwebo aluzange lufunde itafile ukuya ekupheleni.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ukwenza izinto ezingaphezulu kwe-7 kunika inzuzo enkulu ngakumbi, yaye izinto ezili-15 zezona ziphezulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uthelekise amanani enzuzo ngokuthe ngqo waza wafunda ukuba iindleko eziphakathi eziphantsi nenzuzo enkulu kakhulu zinokwahluka.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukhuphiswano luye lwaba nzima ngakumbi yaye ixabiso lokuthengisa ngento nganye lehlele ku-24 (천 원). Iindleko ezimiselweyo ze-50 zisabhatalwa kule nyanga nokuba imveliso iyaphela. Inzuzo = 24q − C(q): −50 ukuba q=0, −5 ukuba q=5, −2 ukuba q=6, −1 ukuba q=7, −2 ukuba q=8, kwaye −10 ukuba q=10.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kweli xabiso, yeyiphi eyona gwebo ifanelekileyo kucwangciso lwemveliso yale nyanga?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwixabiso le-24, yonke imveliso lilahleko. Kodwa iindleko ezimiselweyo ze-50 zibhatalwa nangayiphi na, ngoko −1 kwizinto ezi-7 ingcono kakhulu kune-−50 kwizinto ezi-0. (Ukuba iindleko ezimiselweyo zinokunqandwa, ugwebo lwaluya kutshintsha, kodwa kule ngxaki sicinge ukuba azinakunqandwa.)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ilahleko, kodwa ilahleko incinci kakhulu kwizinto ezi-7, ngoko kungcono ukuzenza.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubandakanye kuthelekiso imeko yokuba iindleko ezimiselweyo zibhatalwa nokuba wenza okanye ungenzi nto. Oku kwahluke kugwebo olushiya iindleko ezimiselweyo ngaphandle.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yonke imveliso lilahleko, ngoko kungcono ukungenzi nto.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Olu gwebo lushiye i-−50 yokungenzi nto. Phantsi kwemeko yokuba iindleko ezimiselweyo zibhatalwa nangayiphi na, thelekisa nenzuzo kwizinto ezi-0.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ukuba wenza izinto ezi-7, apho iindleko eziphakathi zilelona phantsi, le nyanga iya kuba nenzuzo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uphoswe kukuba iindleko eziphakathi ze-24.14 zikhulu kuneexabiso lokuthengisa le-24. Nokuba iindleko eziphakathi eziphantsi kakhulu ziphezulu kunexabiso.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.reflect: Jonga umva amagwebo akho amathathu. Yayinini imveliso enendleko eziphakathi eziphantsi kakhulu ifana nemveliso enenzuzo enkulu kakhulu? Xa ixabiso lokuthengisa litshintsha, imveliso enenzuzo enkulu kakhulu yatshintsha njani?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.prompt: Xa ixabiso lokuthengisa li-40 (천 원), faka imveliso eyahlukileyo ezi-3 q enenzuzo enkulu kunokwenza izinto ezi-7, apho iindleko eziphakathi zilelona phantsi. (q linani eliphelele ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kuma-30)
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha amaxabiso ambalwa e-q anje nge-7, 10, 20, 25, bala inzuzo, uyithelekise ne-111, uze uyihlele etafileni.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukufumana apho iqala ukudlula kwi-111 nalapho iwa ngaphantsi kwakhona, tshintsha q enye ngexesha uvavanye imida.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Linani eliphelele ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kuma-30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c1: q kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kuma-30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Inzuzo ayikhulu kuno-111. Bala 40q − C(q) uze uyithelekise ne-111 yezinto ezi-7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.explain: Inzuzo yi-−q² + 30q − 50, ngoko inkulu kuno-111 kwi-q=8 ukuya kuma-22. Umzekelo: q=8 inika 126, 10 inika 150, 15 inika 175, kwaye 22 inika 126. q=23 inika 111, olilingana, kwaye 25 inika 75, encinci kunezizinto ezi-7. Inzuzo enkulu kakhulu isezintweni ezili-15 (175).
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa amanani, cacisa kutheni, xa ixabiso lokuthengisa li-40, izinto ezi-7 ezineendleko eziphakathi eziphantsi kakhulu zingemveliso enenzuzo enkulu kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka izinto ezi-7 nezinto ezili-10 ecaleni kwenye kwitafile yenzuzo uze ujonge apho umahluko phakathi kwenzuzo ezimbini uvela khona.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala ngokwahlukileyo iindleko ezongezelelweyo nengeniso eyongezelelweyo xa usuka kwizinto ezi-7 uye kwezi-8, uze uzithelekise.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Umzekelo: Xa wenza into enye ngaphezulu kwe-7 ...
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale engcaciso yakho ukuba 'iindleko eziphakathi ngento nganye' 'nenzuzo' ngamanani ahlukeneyo?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uhlolile amanani owasebenzisileyo kwitafile yenzuzo?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ucinge ngenyaniso yokuba isigqibo sinokutshintsha ukuba ixabiso lokuthengisa litshintsha?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Iindleko eziphakathi zindleko zento nganye kuphela. Ukuba ixabiso lokuthengisa li-40, iindleko eziyongezelelweyo ukusuka kwento yesi-8 ngaphezulu kwe-7 (malunga ne-25) zincinci kuno-40, ngoko okukhona wenza ngakumbi, kokukhona inzuzo ikhula. Eneneni, izinto ezi-7 zinika i-111 yaye izinto ezili-15 zinika i-175.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ixabiso li-40, eliyahluka kakhulu kuneendleko eziphakathi ze-24.14. Ukuba nje iindleko eziyongezelelweyo zokwandisa inani lezinto zincinci kunexabiso le-40, ukwenza ngakumbi kunika inzuzo enkulu ngakumbi. Izinto ezili-10 zinika i-150, enkulu kuneyi-111 yezinto ezi-7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Enye inkcazo efaka iindleko eziyongezelelweyo emazwini

y-m-73-01.title: Ukuba inyuka nge-50% emva koko yehle nge-50%
y-m-73-01.topic: Ukusebenzisa utshintsho lweepesenti enye emva kwenye
y-m-73-01.goal: Usebenzisa inyani yokuba utshintsho ngalunye lwepesenti lusekelwe kwixabiso elisanda kudlula, fumana impazamo kwisisombululo esidibanise iipesenti ngokulula, uze wakhe udibaniso lwakho lokonyuka nokwehla ebuyela kwixabiso lokuqala.
y-m-73-01.material: Inani labahambeli bemihla ngemihla kwivenkile ye-intanethi lenyuke nge-50% ukusuka kwinani lokuqala ngoJanuwari, emva koko lehle nge-50% ukusuka kwinani likaJanuwari ngoFebhuwari. Utshintsho ngalunye lwepesenti lusekelwe kwinani labahambeli 'kwinyanga esanda kudlula'. Thatha inani lokuqala labahambeli libe yi-100, uze uthathe iziphumo njengamaxabiso engqiqo apho amadesimali evumelekile. Ngezantsi sisisombululo somfundi omnye.
y-m-73-01.thinking.1: Ukwazi ukuba xa isiseko sitshintsha, ipesenti efanayo iba sisixa esahlukileyo
y-m-73-01.prereq.0: Ukubala ukonyuka nokwehla kwepesenti ngokuphindaphinda (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-73-01.prereq.2: Ileyibhile ye-H3 kulo msebenzi sisikhumbuzi sobunzima seli qela lemveliso kuphela; ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibela oku kwibanga elithile. Ingcamango: umfundi odibana nemathematika yezoqoqosho okokuqala kwinqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphezulu.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye ongalunganga kwesi sisombululo.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, bhala ukuba ithi bangaphi abahambeli, uze ufumane imigca emibini enika amanani ahlukeneyo kwinyanga enye.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga kumgca wesi-2 nowesi-3 ukuba i-+50% kunye ne-−50% nganye yi-50% yaliphi inani.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.0: Thatha inani lokuqala labahambeli libe yi-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.1: NgoJanuwari: abahambeli abangama-100 bayanyuka nge-50% babe ngama-150.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.2: NgoFebhuwari: abahambeli abangama-150 bayehla nge-50% babe ngama-75.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.3: Kuba i-+50% kunye ne-−50% zidibana zibe yi-0%, inani labahambeli ngoFebhuwari li-100, linye nelokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.4: Ngoko inani labahambeli alitshintshanga kwiinyanga ezimbini.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 sele unika abahambeli abangama-75 ngoFebhuwari, kodwa umgca wesi-4 uthi 100, ngoko abahambelani. I-+50% kunye ne-−50% kumgca wesi-4 zineziseko ezahlukeneyo (eyokuqala isekelwe kwi-100, eyesibini kwi-150). Iipesenti zinokudityaniswa nokususwa kuphela xa zinesiseko esifanayo. Ngoko umgca wesi-4 awulunganga, kwaye umgca wesi-5, owakhelwe kuwo, awulunganga nawo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.prompt: Yakha udibaniso olubuyela kanye kwixabiso lokuqala. Ngenisa izibini ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo (p, q) ezinjalo ukuba ixabiso lenyuka nge-p% kwinyanga yokuqala emva koko lehle nge-q% (lisekelwe kwixabiso ngelo xesha) kwinyanga elandelayo, ukuze emva kweenyanga ezimbini lifane kanye nelokuqala. p yi-integer ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-500, kwaye q yi-integer ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha i-p, fumana ixabiso emva kwenyanga yokuqala, uze uzame wena ukuba kufuneka unqumle ipesenti engakanani kulo ukuze ubuyele kwi-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukuba p no-q zinokufana na, kwaye ukuba hayi, thelekisa ukuba q ikhulu okanye incinci kune-p.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c1: I-p kufuneka ibe yi-integer ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-500, kwaye q kufuneka ibe yi-integer ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ixabiso emva kweenyanga ezimbini lifana nelokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso emva kweenyanga ezimbini lahlukile kwelokuqala. Kuqala fumana ixabiso emva kwenyanga yokuqala, uze ujonge ixabiso olifumana ngokunqumla i-q% kulo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.explain: Imizekelo: Ukuba inyuka nge-25% iba yi-125, kwaye kuba i-20% ye-125 yi-25, ukunqumla i-20% kunika i-100. Ukuba inyuka nge-100% iba yi-200, kwaye ukunqumla i-50% kunika i-100; ukuba inyuka nge-150% iba yi-250, kwaye ukunqumla i-60% kunika i-100. (300, 75) kunye ne-(400, 80) zisebenza nazo. Kuba ixabiso emva kokonyuka likhulu, ipesenti yokunqumla efunekayo ukubuyela ihlala incinci kunepesenti yokonyuka.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa inani elinye, chaza isizathu sokuba p no-q zingalingani kudibaniso olwenzileyo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha enye yedibaniso ozenzileyo ngasentla, uze uqale ubhale ixabiso emva kwenyanga yokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Fumana ukuba i-q% yelo xabiso yintoni, uze uyithelekise ne-q% yexabiso lokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Umzekelo: Isiseko sepesenti yokunqumla ukusuka kwi-125 ...
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usebenzise kwingcaciso yakho inyani yokuba ixabiso emva kwenyanga yokuqala lahlukile kwelokuqala?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthethe ngokucacileyo ukuba sisiphi isiseko sepesenti yokunqumla?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubale wena amanani owasebenzisileyo waza wajonga ukuba alungile?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Ixabiso emva kokonyuka liba likhulu kune-100, ngoko isiseko sepesenti yokunqumla siyatshintsha. Ukuba unqumla i-25% yexabiso le-125 elivela ekonyukeni kwe-25%, ufumana i-93.75, ngoko akubuyeli; kufuneka unqumle i-20%, eyi-25, ukufumana i-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Kwinyanga yokuqala isiseko si-100, kwaye kwinyanga yesibini isiseko lixabiso elikhulu ngakumbi i-150. Nakwi-50% efanayo, isixa esinqunyiweyo sikhulu kwi-75, ngoko ipesenti yokunqumla efunekayo ukubuyela inokuba incinci, njengoko umzekelo (150%, 60%) ubonisa.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.2: Ukuba p=25 no-q=20, ukunciphisa i-125 nge-20% kususa i-25, ebuyisela kwi-100. I-25% ye-125 yi-31.25, ngoko ukuseta q ibe yi-25 kunciphisa kakhulu.
